# Fixture Project

The project used to exercise ingestion end-to-end in tests. Architecture is documented in
[[architecture-decision-a|Architecture A (superseded)]] and
[[architecture-decision-b|Architecture B (current)]].

Owner: [[Me]]. Depends on [[PostgreSQL]] and [[Neo4j]]. Related requirement:
[[requirement-fixture-storage]].

See also the [external spec](https://example.com/fixture-spec) (kept as a relative-style markdown
link target for the extractor's link test, even though it is an http(s) URL).
